description: Manifest for ONE checkpoint (one ASR or one LLM, never a pair). A pair is described by two manifests + one checkpoint config. HARD RULE: training lineage is never inferred from a folder name, a model id, or a config value. If the supplier did not state the training data, training_data is exactly 'UNKNOWN'. Likewise a sha256 is always the sha256 of a named file, never of a folder, and licence/release_date are 'UNKNOWN' when not stated by the supplier or the model card for that exact revision.

file_sha256.description: Map from a path in files_required to its sha256 hex digest, computed over that file as stored (the .safetensors file itself, the config.json itself, etc.). Absence of an entry means 'hash not declared', NOT 'hash verified'. Preflight verifies every declared entry and reports undeclared files as hash_status=not_declared.

files_required.description: Literal relative paths inside the checkpoint directory, one per file that must exist and be non-empty. For a merged/full LLM this includes every safetensors shard; for an adapter it includes adapter_model.safetensors (or .bin) AND adapter_config.json, but NOT base weights (the base is a separate load — see load_kind).

license.description: Exact licence string from the model card for this revision, or 'UNKNOWN'.

load_kind.description: LLM only. full = weights as stored; merged = fine-tune already merged into full weights; adapter = PEFT/LoRA adapter directory (base model is NOT in this directory unless files_required says so).

max_context_tokens.description: LLM only: the context the checkpoint is claimed for. Preflight checks it against the 16384 cap; a missing value makes context UNVERIFIED, never assumed 16384.

parameters_b_declared.description: Supplier-declared parameter count in billions. This is a CLAIM, not a measurement: preflight reports it separately from parameters_b_from_artifact, and the budget verdict uses the artifact value when computable, else UNVERIFIED.

release_date.description: Release date stated by the supplier/card for this revision, or 'UNKNOWN'.

revision.description: HF revision / commit hash, or the local directory's identifying hash if the supplier gives one, or 'UNKNOWN' / null for an unpinned local directory. A null revision is not a pin.

source.description: HF id or the supplier's label for the origin. This is provenance text, NOT a load path and NOT proof of training lineage.

status.description: candidate = a real checkpoint offered for preflight. example-only = a schema example that preflight must REFUSE (never a real checkpoint).

training_data.description: Exactly what the supplier states was trained on, or 'UNKNOWN'. Never inferred from a name.

title: LifeMate checkpoint manifest v1 (one checkpoint)
